blocks.text: Is chapter ne software development ke zaroori pehlu pesh kiye: bunyadi tasawwurat aur aham istilahat aur Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) ke marahil. Is ne Waterfall model aur Agile samet software development ke tareeqe aur software project ki planning aur intezam dekha. Is mein quality assurance, tasweeri numaindagi ke liye UML aur design patterns ki ahmiyat, aur aakhir mein debugging ke tareeqe, testing ki hikmat-e-amli aur woh software development tools aaye jo aala maiyar ka software banane mein madad dete hain.
